findings.title: Removing the `.title` float rule may break the header title layout
findings.body: The `.title { float: left; }` rule is deleted outright and nothing replaces it, while `.contents` becomes a flex container. Any header markup still using the `.title` class loses its float and will be positioned by flex rules it was never designed for. The PR does not show that the class is unused, so the header title layout is at risk.

findings.title: `.panel` float removed and replaced with flex ordering without verification
findings.body: `.panel` changes from `float: right` to `margin-left: auto` plus `order(3)`. This only works if `.panel` is a direct flex child of `.contents`. If it is nested under another wrapper, the float is removed with no equivalent layout, and the header can shift in ways the PR does not account for.

findings.title: Bullet badge margin rule removed from extra-info wrapper without replacement
findings.body: The `&.bullet { margin-top: 5px; }` rule inside `.extra-info-wrapper .badge-wrapper` is deleted. Bullet badges in this wrapper lose their 5px top offset, which changes their vertical alignment. The diff also adds an unrelated `line-height: 1.5` to the same wrapper, which is not explained.

findings.title: Small-action description spacing reduced without clear justification
findings.body: `.small-action-desc` padding changes from `0.5em 0 0.5em 4em` to `0 1.5%`, the `margin-top: 5px` is dropped, and the nested `p` margin and padding are changed as well. The left indent of 4em that reserves room for the avatar is removed, so the text can overlap the `.topic-avatar` column. These are visible layout changes with no supporting description or test.

findings.title: `align-items` mixin emits a non-existent `-ms-align-items` property
findings.body: `-ms-align-items` is not a real vendor-prefixed property, so the declaration is dropped by browsers and is dead output. `-webkit-box-align` also accepts only box-model values, so the mixin is misleading for the flexbox intent. The mixin should emit only valid properties.

findings.title: PR description is empty and the title does not match the changes
findings.body: The description reads only 'Test 5', so reviewers get no rationale for the layout changes. The title claims a performance optimization, but the diff is a visual layout rewrite (float to flexbox, spacing and margin changes) with no measurements or verification of the intended behavior.
